title: 2023年6月四级真题 第1套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 Most of us in the entrepreneurial community are blessed—or cursed—with higher-than-average ambition. Ambitious people strongly desire accomplishments and are willing to take more risks and spend more effort to get them.

P2 Overall, this is a positive quality, especially for people trying to build their own businesses. Apparently, if you're more naturally driven to set goals, you are more likely to succeed.

P3 Actually, this isn't always the case. In fact, in some cases, extreme ambition may end up doing more harm than good.

P4 One major side effect of excessive ambition is the tendency to focus too determinedly on one particular vision or end goal. This is problematic because it hinders your ability to adapt to new circumstances, which is vital if you want to be a successful entrepreneur. If a new competitor emerges to threaten your business, you may need to change direction, even if that means straying from your original vision. If you have too much ambition, you'll find this hard, if not impossible.

P5 Few people are successful when they try to build their first brand. Unfortunately, for the most ambitious entrepreneurs, a failure is seen as disastrous, and impossible to recover from.

P6 It's a clear departure from the intended plan toward the intended goal. For people with limited ambition, however, failure is viewed as something closer to reality. Remember, failure is inevitable, and every failure you survive is a learning experience.

P7 Ambitious people tend to be more materialistically successful than their non-ambitious counterparts. However, they're only slightly happier than their less-ambitious counterparts, and tend to live significantly shorter lives. This implies that even though ambitious people are more likely to achieve conventional "success," such success means nothing for their health and happiness—and if you don't have health and happiness, what else could possibly matter?

P8 Clearly, some amount of ambition is good for your motivation. Without any ambition, you wouldn't start your own business, set or achieve goals and get far in life. But an excess of ambition can also be dangerous, putting you at risk of burnout, stubbornness and even a shorter life.

questions.q: What does the author think of most entrepreneurs?
options: They are more willing to risk their own lives.
They are more ambitious than ordinary people.
They achieve greater nonconventional success.
They have more positive qualities than most of us.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author think of most entrepreneurs? 直接问对一个明确对象的看 法，答案能在原文某句找到对应陈述，不需跨段综合，属细节题而非推断。

【拆句】题干 What does the author think of most entrepreneurs? 是 think of 引导的特殊疑问 句，think of sb 意为"对某人的看法"，结构平铺直叙、无陷阱。

【定位】Most of us in the entrepreneurial community are blessed—or cursed—with higher-than- average ambition. 我们创业圈里的大多数人，都被赋予——或者说被困于——高于常人的野心。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 原文说野心者 willing to take more risks 指愿冒事业风险，选项却说 risk their own lives（拿命冒险），把"风险"偷换成"生命危险"。 B) ✓ 正确 higher-than-average ambition ↔more ambitious than ordinary people 选项 They are more ambitious than ordinary people 与预判"野心高于普通人"完全吻 合，是定位句的同义替换。 C) 无中生有 原文谈的是 conventional "success"（传统成功），选项却说 nonconventional success（非传统成功），文中从无此说法。 D) 以偏概全 原文只说野心 this is a positive quality 是"一种"积极特质，选项却说创业者 more positive qualities than most of us"比我们多"，既夸大数量又把比较对象搞错（原文 most of us 本就包含创业者）。 作者说"情况并非总是如此"(第3段第1行)意味着什么? A) 有雄心的人可能没有更大的成功机会。 B) 有雄心的人可能没有更多积极品质。 C) 企业家的雄心带来的好处和坏处一样多。 D) 企业家更天然地被驱使走向成功。

questions.q: What does the author imply by saying "this isn't always the case" (Line 1, Para. 3)?
options: Ambitious people may not have a greater chance of success.
Ambitious people may not have more positive qualities.
Entrepreneurs' ambition does as much good as harm.
Entrepreneurs are more naturally driven to success.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author imply by saying "this isn't always the case" 用 imply by saying 问一个具体句子的含义，要求理解 this 指代什么、否定的是什么，属词义句意题。

【拆句】题干主干 What does the author imply，by saying "..." 是方式状语；关键在引文里的 this 是指代词，须回原文找它替代的上文内容；isn't always 是部分否定，意为"并非总 是"，不是全盘否定。 52. What does the author imply by saying "this isn't always the case" (Line 1, Para. 3)? A) Ambitious people may not have a greater chance of success. B) Ambitious people may not have more positive qualities. C) Entrepreneurs' ambition does as much good as harm. D) Entrepreneurs are more naturally driven to success.

【定位】Actually, this isn't always the case. 实际上，情况并非总是如此。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 you are more likely to succeed ↔may not have a greater chance of success 选项 Ambitious people may not have a greater chance of success 正是"this（野心 者更易成功）＋部分否定"的还原，与预判一致。 B) 偷换概念 this 指代的是"更易成功"，并非"积极特质"；选项 may not have more positive qualities 把否定矛头指向上一段的 positive quality，找错了 this 的指代。 C) 与原文相反 原文只说极端野心 may end up doing more harm than good（弊"大于"利），选项 却说 does as much good as harm（利害"相当"），把"大于"篡改成"相等"。 D) 与原文相反 选项 more naturally driven to success 几乎照搬上文 more naturally driven to set goals，可这恰是本句要否定的观点，方向正好相反。 作者认为对于成为成功的企业家来说,什么是极其重要的? A) 坚持自己最初的愿景。 B) 能够适应新的情况。 C) 坚定地专注于某一特定目标。 D) 避免在职业方向上发生剧烈变化。

questions.q: What does the author say is of extreme importance for one to become a successful entrepreneur?
options: Holding on to one's original vision.
Being able to adapt to new situations.
Focusing determinedly on one particular goal.
Avoiding radical change in one's career direction.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author say is of extreme importance 用 say 直问作者明说的内容， 答案是原文一句强调重要性的话，属细节题。

【拆句】题干 What does the author say is of extreme importance for one to become a successful entrepreneur?，主干是 What...is of extreme importance；of+抽象名词等于 形容词，of extreme importance＝extremely important；for one to become... 是不定 式目的状语，指明"为了成为成功创业者"。

【定位】This is problematic because it hinders your ability to adapt to new circumstances, which is vital if you want to be a successful entrepreneur. 这是有问题的，因为它会损害你适应新环境的能力，而这种能力对于想成为成功创业者的人 至关重要。 53. What does the author say is of extreme importance for one to become a successful entrepreneur? A) Holding on to one's original vision. B) Being able to adapt to new situations. C) Focusing determinedly on one particular goal. D) Avoiding radical change in one's career direction.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文说过度野心导致 focus too determinedly on one particular vision 反而有害，需 straying from your original vision；选项 Holding on to one's original vision（死守 原愿景）正是文章要批评的做法。 B) ✓ 正确 adapt to new circumstances ↔adapt to new situations 选项 Being able to adapt to new situations 与预判"适应新环境的能力"几乎逐词对 应，确为答案。 C) 与原文相反 选项 Focusing determinedly on one particular goal 直接抄自 focus too determinedly on one particular vision，而原文说这是过度野心的"副作用"，绝非"极 其重要"之事。 D) 与原文相反 原文说有时须 change direction"改变方向"，选项却说 Avoiding radical change in one's career direction"避免大改方向"，与文意相左。 最有雄心的企业家如何看待他们事业中的失败? A) 失败会让他们认清现实。 B) 失败是他们必须学习的一课。 C) 失败意味着他们职业生涯的终结。 D) 失败会导致缓慢的恢复。

questions.q: How do the most ambitious entrepreneurs regard failure in their endeavor?
options: It will awaken them to reality.
It is a lesson they have to learn.
It means the end of their career.
It will result in a slow recovery.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 How do the most ambitious entrepreneurs regard failure 问一个明确群体对失败 的态度，原文有明文表述，属细节题。

【拆句】题干 How do the most ambitious entrepreneurs regard failure in their endeavor?， regard sth 意为"看待某事"，in their endeavor（在其奋斗中）是范围状语；结构清晰、无 陷阱。

【定位】Unfortunately, for the most ambitious entrepreneurs, a failure is seen as disastrous, and impossible to recover from. 不幸的是，对那些野心最大的创业者来说，一次失败被视为灾难性的、且无法翻身的。 54. How do the most ambitious entrepreneurs regard failure in their endeavor? A) It will awaken them to reality. B) It is a lesson they have to learn. C) It means the end of their career. D) It will result in a slow recovery.

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 awaken them to reality 对应的是第六段 failure is viewed as something closer to reality，那讲的是"野心有限者"，而非题干问的"野心最大者"。 B) 张冠李戴 a lesson they have to learn 对应第六段 every failure you survive is a learning experience，同样是说"野心有限者"，张冠李戴。 C) ✓ 正确 disastrous, and impossible to recover from ↔means the end of their career 选项 It means the end of their career 把"灾难、无法恢复"提炼成"事业到头"，与预判 一致，确为答案。 D) 与原文相反 原文说 impossible to recover from"无法恢复"，选项却说 result in a slow recovery"导致缓慢恢复"，恢复从"不可能"被偷改成"慢"。 关于雄心,作者建议我们做什么? A) 区分传统成功与我们的人生目标。 B) 效仿最有雄心的企业家的榜样。 C) 创业时避免承担不必要的风险。 D) 将健康和幸福置于物质成功之上。

questions.q: What does the author advise us to do concerning ambition?
options: Distinguish between conventional success and our life goal.
Follow the example of the most ambitious entrepreneurs.
Avoid taking unnecessary risks when starting a business.
Prioritize health and happiness over material success.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author advise us to do concerning ambition? 问作者的建议，原文 未必有一句直说"我建议你……"，需综合全文对野心利弊的论述提炼，属推断题。

【拆句】题干 What does the author advise us to do concerning ambition?，advise sb to do 意为"建议某人做某事"，concerning ambition（关于野心）是话题状语；结构平铺直叙、 无陷阱。 55. What does the author advise us to do concerning ambition? A) Distinguish between conventional success and our life goal. B) Follow the example of the most ambitious entrepreneurs. C) Avoid taking unnecessary risks when starting a business. D) Prioritize health and happiness over material success.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 原文要区分的是 conventional "success" 与 health and happiness，选项 Distinguish between conventional success and our life goal 把后一项换成了文中没有的"人生目 标"，区分对象被改错。 B) 与原文相反 全文都在指出 the most ambitious entrepreneurs 看待失败的方式有害，选项 Follow the example of the most ambitious entrepreneurs 却劝人效仿他们，与作者立场正 相反。 C) 以偏概全 Avoid taking unnecessary risks 只关乎 take more risks 这一点，并非全文劝诫的落 脚；作者最终落点是健康幸福，而非"少冒险"，以偏概全且无中生有。 D) ✓ 正确 such success means nothing for their health and happiness—and if you don't have health and happiness, what else could possibly matter? ↔Prioritize health and happiness over material success 选项 Prioritize health and happiness over material success 与主线"健康幸福重于成 功"吻合，且统摄全文对过度野心的批评，是建议题应有的全局答案。
